university: Hochschule München University of Applied Sciences
other_notes: One of Germany's top Universities of Applied Sciences. Highly practical education, excellent connections with companies like BMW and Siemens, and outstanding value for money.
rank_justification: Excellent value for money and outstanding industry links in Munich. Ranked lower because my priorities place greater emphasis on international prestige and research-intensive universities.
review_flags: German admission usually depends on your IB subject combination and grades. Check whether the SAT is required at all, and treat the IB score range as an estimate.
